mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, increasing corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average and a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals a shift from supply-driven to demand-driven economic activity, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 12mo_ma and HOUST < 12mo_ma.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 6 months signals an aggressive monetary policy response, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, the signal (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5pp in 6 months) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals robust consumer demand and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST shows positive trend but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS growth > 100k in 3 months, SPX 5d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% year-over-year and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 6 months signals an accommodative monetary policy response to inflationary pressures, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5pp in 6 months
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5pp in 6 months, SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% monthly), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the manufacturing slowdown regime, INDPRO falls > 1% in 3 months but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
